ops.text: e. Client Ownership. As between the parties, Client retains all right, title and interest in and to the Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property and all data provided by or on behalf of Client or its customers, brokers or borrowers, and nothing in this Agreement operates as an assignment or transfer of any such rights to TrueLink, other than the limited license expressly granted in Section 8(d). All results of the Support Services and any other materials prepared by TrueLink specifically for Client under this Agreement shall be the sole property of Client, and TrueLink hereby assigns to Client all right, title and interest therein. To the extent any TrueLink Intellectual Property is embedded in such results or materials, TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to such TrueLink Intellectual Property as part of such results or materials. No jointly owned intellectual property is created under this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 2(d) confirms only TrueLink's ownership of the Interface, so we add a reciprocal paragraph vesting Client with the results and materials TrueLink prepares for it, reserving Client's Content, IP and borrower/loan data, and licensing back any embedded TrueLink IP on a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free basis. The embedded-IP licence is now limited to those three attributes, and TrueLink's Interface rights and its Section 8(d) Credit Data licence are unaffected.
